definitions.complete: All public exports and class members are present; doctest and unit-test evidence passes strict omission/gap checks; no recorded limitation. A module without an upstream SymPy test file has no applicable unit-test criterion and relies on the per-file 100% coverage of its own tests.
definitions.partial: A source counterpart exists, but at least one measured completeness criterion fails (see completeness).
definitions.unimplemented: Inspected mathematical module without an implementation.
definitions.unassessed: Not assessed; never treated as implemented or deliberately excluded.
definitions.excluded: An explicit runtime, infrastructure or project-scope exclusion, with its reason.
definitions.note: For partial and unimplemented modules: what is ported, or where the module is planned (base module or an extend package).
definitions.declaredPublicNames: Public source definitions, explicit __all__ exports and declared class methods/properties. The API criterion also checks inherited members and class attributes. Python protocols are excluded except mapped arithmetic/comparison operators.
